result.instructions: Tools for Easy Employer, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is rostered on at our Sydney site tomorrow, and which shifts are still open?"; "List the leave requests waiting for this month, grouped by user."; "Show the timesheet shifts from last week that have no matching roster shift.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Easy Employer data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run easyemployer_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run easyemployer_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run easyemployer_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. easyemployer_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: easyemployer_get_settings
tools.title: Get organisation settings
tools.description: Get the organisation name, time zone, and feature flags (timesheets, flexible leave) for the configured organisation. Good first call to check the connection. API: GET /org/{org}/settings.

tools.name: easyemployer_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List employees (users) in the organisation. Optional `include` and `filter` take the JSON strings the API documents, e.g. filter {"active":{"eq":true}}. API: GET /api/2/users.

include.description: JSON array string of payload parts to include, e.g. ["personal_details","contact_details"].

tools.name: easyemployer_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one employee by user ID, with contact, employment and pay fields. API: GET /api/1/user/{user_id}.

tools.name: easyemployer_list_roster_shifts
tools.title: List roster shifts
tools.description: List assigned roster shifts (who is rostered where and when) with optional date range and paging. API: GET /org/{org}/assigned_roster_shift.

date_start.description: Shifts starting at or after this Unix timestamp.

date_end.description: Shifts ending at or before this Unix timestamp.

include_group.description: Include this extra detail in the response.

include_roles.description: Include this extra detail in the response.

tools.name: easyemployer_list_unassigned_roster_shifts
tools.title: List open roster shifts
tools.description: List roster shifts that have no employee assigned yet (open shifts), with optional date range. API: GET /org/{org}/unassigned_roster_shift.

date_start.description: Shifts starting at or after this Unix timestamp.

date_end.description: Shifts ending at or before this Unix timestamp.

include_group.description: Include this extra detail in the response.

tools.name: easyemployer_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List organisation groups (areas, roles, sites) that shifts and users belong to. API: GET /api/1/group.

type.description: Group type to filter for, e.g. area, role or site.

tools.name: easyemployer_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List the roles defined in the organisation. API: GET /api/2/roles.

tools.name: easyemployer_list_awards
tools.title: List awards
tools.description: List the awards (pay and conditions rules) the organisation uses. API: GET /api/2/awards.

tools.name: easyemployer_list_timesheet_shifts
tools.title: List timesheet shifts
tools.description: List actual (clocked) timesheet shifts with optional date range. Use these for payroll checks. API: GET /org/{org}/actual_shift.

date_start.description: Shifts starting at or after this Unix timestamp.

date_end.description: Shifts ending at or before this Unix timestamp.

tools.name: easyemployer_list_leave
tools.title: List leave requests
tools.description: List leave requests, optionally for one user and a date range. API: GET /org/{org}/leave.

user_id.description: Only leave for this user ID.

date_start.description: Leave whose start date is at or after this Unix timestamp.

date_end.description: Leave whose end date is at or before this Unix timestamp.

tools.name: easyemployer_list_leave_types
tools.title: List leave types
tools.description: List the leave types (e.g. annual, sick) the organisation offers. API: GET /org/{org}/leave_type.

user_id.description: Only leave types available to this user ID.

tools.name: easyemployer_create_leave_request
tools.title: Create a leave request
tools.description: Create a leave request for a user. This creates a record the user and managers see; it does not approve it. Dates are Unix timestamps in seconds. API: POST /org/{org}/leave.

user_id.description: The user the leave is for.

paid.description: 1 if the leave is paid, 0 if unpaid.

date_start_all_day.description: 1 if the leave covers all of the start day.

date_end_all_day.description: 1 if the leave covers all of the end day.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Easy Employer
prompts.description: What you can do with Easy Employer here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: see_who_is_rostered_and_which_shifts_are_open
prompts.title: See who is rostered and which shifts are open
prompts.description: List the assigned roster shifts by date. List the open shifts that have no employee yet.

prompts.name: check_timesheets_against_the_roster
prompts.title: Check timesheets against the roster
prompts.description: List the clocked timesheet shifts by date for payroll checks, and compare them with the roster.

prompts.name: review_leave_requests
prompts.title: Review leave requests
prompts.description: List leave requests for one user or a date range. List the leave types the organisation offers.

prompts.name: look_up_an_employee_and_their_groups
prompts.title: Look up an employee and their groups
prompts.description: List the users, open one for its contact and employment fields, and list the groups.

prompts.name: create_a_leave_request
prompts.title: Create a leave request
prompts.description: Create a leave request for a user. It creates the request only; it does not approve it.
